microsoft365.client_impact: May affect Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online mail flow, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra sign-in, Intune, Microsoft 365 Apps, Defender, Power Platform, and dependent client workflows.
microsoft365.technician_action: Check Microsoft public and Entra status, then tenant Service Health before changing client DNS, identity, mail, endpoint, or collaboration configuration.

kaseya.client_impact: May affect Autotask PSA, Datto, Kaseya RMM, backup, or MSP operations.
kaseya.technician_action: Confirm the affected US product and region on the Kaseya status page before changing local systems.
